setting.label: Show previous / up next panel
setting.help: When enabled, show panels displaying previous and upcoming songs. When disabled, hides these panels.

setting.label: Prevent screensaver during playback
setting.help: Keeps the now-playing widget visible instead of letting Kodi's screensaver kick in while a station is playing.

setting.label: Sync now-playing display to actual audio
setting.help: Delays the title, artwork and progress bar so they change when the audio itself changes, instead of when Rainwave reports it -- compensates for the stream's own buffering delay.

setting.label: Stream buffer delay (seconds)
setting.help: How far behind Rainwave's reported now-playing the actual audio arrives. Increase if the title/artwork still change before you hear the new song; decrease if they change after. 15-20 is typical.

setting.label: Show picture slideshow behind Now Playing
setting.help: Enable or disable the background slideshow.

setting.label: Background source
setting.help: Local folder: shuffle through your own pictures, unrelated to what's playing. Automatic: fetch each game's own art from SteamGridDB and switch to it as that game plays. Random: shuffle through art already fetched via Automatic mode, unrelated to what's playing.

setting.label: Automatic mode fallback
setting.help: What to show while Automatic mode has no art yet (or none at all) for the current song. Local folder needs the picture folder below configured; Random reuses whatever's already been fetched via Automatic mode -- it needs that to have found at least a few games already, so it may show nothing at first.

setting.label: Picture folder
setting.help: Used as the picture source in Local folder mode. In Automatic mode, used as a fallback whenever no game art has been found yet (or at all) for the current song and the fallback above is set to Local folder -- optional otherwise.

setting.label: SteamGridDB API key
setting.help: Free -- generate one at steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences/api after creating an account. Required for automatic background art; nothing is fetched without it.

setting.label: Background images per game
setting.help: How many pieces of art to fetch and rotate through for each game. Higher gives more variety for long songs or games that air often; 'All' fetches everything SteamGridDB has for that game.

setting.label: Art cache size limit (MB)
setting.help: Fetched game art is kept permanently so it doesn't need re-downloading -- once this limit is reached, the least recently shown games' art is deleted first to make room. 0 = unlimited.

setting.label: Clear art cache
setting.help: Deletes every downloaded background image and starts fresh. Asks for confirmation first.

setting.label: Seconds per image
setting.help: Define how long each image stays on screen before rotating to the ntext.

setting.label: Look up sibling games for more art
setting.help: Enable / Disable extended search to games from the same series to match the number set for background images.
